entries.reason: owed: not a missing measurement but an unreachable one. The ninety-one names were read out of ARKitCore's __const (a hundred and eight consecutive const char * at 0x1d6d4f988, the last seventeen being CoreIK bone names and the ninety-one joints starting at 0x1d6d4fa10), and the hierarchy behind them is in neither image: -[ARSkeletonDefinition initDefault3DSkeletonDefinition] at 0x1af1a8fc4 builds both arrays in a loop over a CoreIK rig, asking CoreIK for each joint's name and for its parent's name, so the parent table is a result and not a constant. The rig description it reads is ARKitCore's own __const at 0x1af24cce0 through 0x1af24d850 and those words are floats - a bone's rest pose, not an index - and the one run of small integers in that __const is periodic with period 18, which a parent table for ninety-one joints cannot be. A definition with the right ninety-one names and no parents is not Apple's definition, so the row stays owed until that table is read. facts/ARKit/Skeleton.md and facts/ARKit/Pose.md
